name: Suffering extends Skull of Gul'dan's duration by 5 seconds (#961)
contract: Suffering 807430 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (misc=1, SPELLMOD_DURATION) with EffectBasePoints=4999, DieSides=1, so its real amount is 4999+1=5000 ms. Its classmask (family 20, dword2 bit6) matches Skull of Gul'dan 800225 by SpellFamilyFlags, and the generic SPELLMOD_DURATION application adds a flat 5000 ms to any matching spell's duration.
